Reasoning: This is an ideal single-phase half-wave controlled rectifier circuit with a freewheeling diode. According to the specified method, the average load voltage formula is V_avg = Vm(1 + cos alpha)/(2π). The source peak value in the figure is Vm = 325 V, and the target average voltage is V_avg = 70 V, therefore 70 = 325(1 + cos alpha)/(2π). So 1 + cos alpha = 70·2π/325 ≈ 1.353, cos alpha ≈ 0.353, alpha = cos^(-1)(0.353) ≈ 69.3°. According to the approximate integer/standard option required by the problem, take alpha ≈ 70°.
